audit_title: AL KASWA HOLDINGS ERP - JWT SECURITY VERIFICATION AUDIT REPORT

jwt_secret.verification: Managed via getJwtSecret() helper in startup/securityValidation.ts. Dynamically loaded from process.env.JWT_SECRET or initialized with a 256-bit entropy random key.

jwt_refresh_secret.verification: Managed via getJwtRefreshSecret() helper in startup/securityValidation.ts. Dynamically loaded from process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET or initialized with a 256-bit entropy random key.

token_generation.verification: Access tokens (15m expiration) and Refresh tokens (7d expiration) generated with distinct cryptographically isolated secrets.

token_validation.verification: Strict signature and payload validation enforced in server auth routes and verifySessionToken middleware.

session_middleware.verification: verifySessionToken extracts Bearer tokens and attaches validated user claims to req.user without trusting header spoofs.

founder_authentication.verification: Founder role (FND) verified via authenticated JWT token claims and founderSafetyLock middleware.

rbac_middleware.verification: Role-based access control enforces multi-tenant boundary checks and role capabilities strictly.

exact_findings: No hardcoded static secrets, test keys, or fallback strings exist in any active TypeScript application logic.
Development fallbacks are generated at runtime using crypto.randomBytes(32) providing 256 bits of cryptographic entropy per server restart.
Production mode (NODE_ENV=production) strictly rejects startup and throws a fatal security exception if process.env.JWT_SECRET or process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET are missing.
remediation_actions: Refactored /startup/securityValidation.ts to export getJwtSecret() and getJwtRefreshSecret() helper functions.
Updated /server.ts to utilize dynamic secure key getters instead of hardcoded fallbacks.
Updated /src/server/rbacEngine.ts to execute token signature verification against the secure getJwtSecret() getter.
recommendations: Ensure process.env.JWT_SECRET and process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET are configured in Cloud Run environment configuration for production deployments.
Maintain key rotation policy every 90 days in cloud secrets manager.
